title: Unsupervised learning defines liver injury phenotypes in pulmonary hypertension
summary: K-means clustering with factor analysis on liver laboratory panels of 4,219 patients from 13 PAH/CTEPH trials identified four phenotypes (no injury, hepatocellular, cholestatic, combined), and findings were validated in 1,756 patients from two other trials. The cholestatic cluster had the shortest time to clinical worsening, and randomization to active treatment was associated with transitions to healthier clusters. Retrospective trial data and relatively simple clustering. Preprint of 2023-09-30.
